title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Hyperthyroidism
intro: Herbal creams for Hyperthyroidism are topical preparations made from various plants and herbs that are believed to help alleviate symptoms associated with an overactive thyroid gland. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat hyperthyroidism include reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and providing natural pain relief. Some examples of herbal creams used to treat hyperthyroidism include creams infused with ashwagandha, which helps to reduce stress and anxiety, creams containing wild yam, which has anti-inflammatory properties, and creams with the herb bugleweed, which is known to regulate thyroid function. Additionally, creams with ingredients like bladder wrack, guggul, and licorice root are also used, as they are thought to support thyroid function and alleviate symptoms associated with hyperthyroidism.
